field_definitions.actions[]: Per-finding fix and suppression suggestions. Each entry carries a `type` discriminant (kebab-case) plus a per-action `auto_fixable` bool. Consumers dispatch on `type` to choose the remediation and filter on `auto_fixable` of each individual entry.
field_definitions.actions[].auto_fixable: Evaluated PER FINDING, not per action type. The same `type` may carry `auto_fixable: true` on one finding and `auto_fixable: false` on another when per-instance guards in the `fallow fix` applier discriminate. Filter on this bool of each individual action, not on `type` alone. Current per-instance flips: (1) `remove-catalog-entry` is `true` only when the finding's `hardcoded_consumers` array is empty (else fallow fix skips the entry to avoid breaking `pnpm install`); (2) the primary dependency action flips between `remove-dependency` (`auto_fixable: true`) and `move-dependency` (`auto_fixable: false`) based on `used_in_workspaces`; (3) `add-to-config` for `ignoreExports` is `true` when fallow fix can safely apply the action, which means EITHER a fallow config file already exists OR no config exists and the working directory is NOT inside a monorepo subpackage (the applier then creates `.fallowrc.json` using `fallow init`'s framework-aware scaffolding and layers the new rules on top); `false` inside a monorepo subpackage with no workspace-root config because the applier refuses to fragment per-package configs; (4) `update-catalog-reference` is always `false` today (catalog-switching applier not yet wired). All `suppress-line` and `suppress-file` actions are uniformly `false`.

boundary-call-violation.name: Boundary Call Violation
boundary-call-violation.description: A file classified into a boundary zone calls a callee matching one of the zone's forbidden call patterns.

boundary-coverage.name: Boundary Coverage
boundary-coverage.description: A reachable source file is not assigned to any configured boundary zone while boundary coverage is required.

boundary-violation.name: Boundary Violations
boundary-violation.description: A module imports from a zone that its configured boundary rules do not allow.

circular-dependency.name: Circular Dependencies
circular-dependency.description: A cycle in the module import graph.

dev-dependency-in-production.name: Dev Dependencies Used in Production
dev-dependency-in-production.description: devDependencies imported by production source code via a runtime/value import; they should be promoted to dependencies.

duplicate-export.name: Duplicate Exports
duplicate-export.description: The same export name is defined in multiple modules.

duplicate-prop-shape.name: Duplicate prop shape
duplicate-prop-shape.description: Multiple React or Preact components declare an identical significant prop-name set.

dynamic-segment-name-conflict.name: Dynamic segment name conflict
dynamic-segment-name-conflict.description: Sibling Next.js dynamic route segments use different slug names at the same position.

empty-catalog-group.name: Empty catalog group
empty-catalog-group.description: A named package manager catalog group has no package entries.

invalid-client-export.name: Invalid client export
invalid-client-export.description: A file carrying the use client directive also exports a Next.js server-only or route-segment config name.

misconfigured-dependency-override.name: Misconfigured pnpm dependency override
misconfigured-dependency-override.description: A pnpm dependency override key or value does not parse as a valid override spec.

misplaced-directive.name: Misplaced directive
misplaced-directive.description: A use client or use server directive string appears after a non-directive statement and is ignored.

missing-suppression-reason.name: Missing Suppression Reason
missing-suppression-reason.description: A fallow-ignore-next-line or fallow-ignore-file suppression omits the explanatory reason required by the requireSuppressionReason rule. Add a short reason after the suppression token, or remove the suppression if the issue is no longer intentional.

mixed-client-server-barrel.name: Mixed client/server barrel
mixed-client-server-barrel.description: A barrel file forwards a name from a use client module alongside a name from a server-only module.

policy-violation.name: Policy Violation
policy-violation.description: A call site, import, or catalogue-derived effect matched a configured rule pack rule.

private-type-leak.name: Private Type Leaks
private-type-leak.description: Exported values or types whose public TypeScript signature references a same-file type declaration that is not exported.

prop-drilling.name: Prop drilling
prop-drilling.description: A React or Preact prop is forwarded unchanged through multiple pass-through components to a distant consumer.

re-export-cycle.name: Re-Export Cycles
re-export-cycle.description: A barrel file re-exports from another barrel that ultimately re-exports back.

route-collision.name: Route collision
route-collision.description: Two or more Next.js App Router route files resolve to the same URL within one app root.

stale-suppression.name: Stale Suppressions
stale-suppression.description: A fallow suppression comment or tag no longer matches any active issue.

test-only-dependency.name: Test-only Dependencies
test-only-dependency.description: Production dependencies that are only imported from test files.

thin-wrapper.name: Thin wrapper
thin-wrapper.description: A React or Preact component is structural indirection around a single spread-forwarded child render.

type-only-dependency.name: Type-only Dependencies
type-only-dependency.description: Production dependencies that are only imported via type-only imports.

unlisted-dependency.name: Unlisted Dependencies
unlisted-dependency.description: Packages imported in source code but not listed in package.json.

unprovided-inject.name: Unprovided injects
unprovided-inject.description: A Vue inject or Svelte getContext reads a dependency-injection key that no matching provider supplies.

unrendered-component.name: Unrendered components
unrendered-component.description: A Vue or Svelte single-file component is reachable through the graph but rendered nowhere in the project.

unresolved-catalog-reference.name: Unresolved catalog reference
unresolved-catalog-reference.description: A workspace package.json uses a catalog protocol reference that no catalog declares.

unresolved-import.name: Unresolved Imports
unresolved-import.description: Import specifiers that could not be resolved to a file on disk.

unused-catalog-entry.name: Unused catalog entry
unused-catalog-entry.description: A package manager catalog entry is not referenced by any workspace package.json.

unused-class-member.name: Unused Class Members
unused-class-member.description: Class methods and properties that are never referenced outside the class.

unused-component-emit.name: Unused component emits
unused-component-emit.description: A Vue script setup defineEmits event is emitted nowhere in its own component.

unused-component-input.name: Unused component inputs
unused-component-input.description: An Angular input is read nowhere in its own component.

unused-component-output.name: Unused component outputs
unused-component-output.description: An Angular output is emitted nowhere in its own component.

unused-component-prop.name: Unused component props
unused-component-prop.description: A declared Vue, Svelte, React, or Preact component prop is referenced nowhere inside its own component.

unused-dependency.name: Unused Dependencies
unused-dependency.description: Packages listed in dependencies that are never imported or required by any source file.

unused-dependency-override.name: Unused pnpm dependency override
unused-dependency-override.description: A pnpm dependency override targets a package not declared by any workspace package and not present in the lockfile.

unused-dev-dependency.name: Unused Dev Dependencies
unused-dev-dependency.description: Packages listed in devDependencies that are never imported by test files, config files, or scripts.

unused-enum-member.name: Unused Enum Members
unused-enum-member.description: Enum members that are never referenced in the codebase.

unused-export.name: Unused Exports
unused-export.description: Named exports that are never imported by any other module in the project, including direct exports and re-exports through barrel files.

unused-file.name: Unused Files
unused-file.description: Source files that are not imported by any other module and are not entry points. Detection uses graph reachability from configured entry points.

unused-load-data-key.name: Unused load data keys
unused-load-data-key.description: A SvelteKit load return-object key is read by no route or project-wide consumer.

unused-optional-dependency.name: Unused Optional Dependencies
unused-optional-dependency.description: Packages listed in optionalDependencies that are never imported.

unused-server-action.name: Unused server actions
unused-server-action.description: A Next.js Server Action exported from a use server file is referenced by no code in the project.

unused-store-member.name: Unused Store Members
unused-store-member.description: Pinia store members declared but never accessed by any consumer project-wide.

unused-svelte-event.name: Unused Svelte events
unused-svelte-event.description: A Svelte component dispatches a custom event whose name is listened to nowhere in the analyzed project.

unused-type.name: Unused Type Exports
unused-type.description: Type-only exports that are never imported. These do not generate runtime code but add maintenance burden.

next_steps.reason: verify an export is truly unused before deleting
